title: Model provision (front matter)
description: YAML front matter of content/provisions/<chapter>-<section>.md. The Markdown body holds the provision text, with alternatives in fenced blocks marked by alternative id and placeholders written as {{variable.name}}.

id.description: Chapter and section, e.g. 02-104 or 02-104A. Equals the file name.

track.description: The part of the code the provision belongs to. Peacemaking is its own track, distinct from Western ADR forms. Tracks organize the book; the processes a provision governs are listed in 'methods', which is open.

methods.description: Dispute resolution methods the provision governs or allows. A provision may also allow processes not listed, for example through a general clause; see docs/decisions/0012-open-list-of-dispute-resolution-methods.md.

variables.description: Placeholders used in the body, defined in content/variables/.

related_sources.description: Source keys of enacted laws or model acts this provision draws on.

since.description: Content version that first published this provision.

replaced_by.description: If withdrawn, the provision id that replaces it.
